comment: The English name, else the first.
The English description, else the first.
Used when the dataflow has no description; with neither, the description is the name.
The dataflow URN (its urn attribute, else built from agencyID, id and version) as a PropertyValue; schema:url is the dataflow's SDMX-REST URL when --endpoint is given.
.Stat Suite writes the date of the last data load as dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss. With no date, dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
The start of the dataflow's validity, used when there is no LAST_UPDATE.
When the service last computed which data the dataflow holds (an Actual constraint), used when the dataflow itself has no date.
The Agency in the message's agency schemes, with its contacts, as an Organization; the bare id when the message has no agency scheme.
The DataProvider of each provision agreement for the dataflow, as an Organization.
Each category the dataflow is categorised under, as a DefinedTerm in its category scheme.
The TIME_PERIOD range of a content constraint attached to the dataflow, as an ISO 8601 interval.

Each dimension, time dimension, primary measure and attribute as a cdi:InstanceVariable: name the component id (the SDMX-CSV column), propertyID its concept URN, cdif:role Dimension / Measure / Attribute, and a codelist as a SubstantiveValueDomain whose EnumerationDomain references the codelist. An attribute qualifies the first dimension it is attached to, else the primary measure.

The SDMX-REST data query {endpoint}data/{agency},{id},{version}/all as a DataDownload, with the DSD as its cdi:DimensionalDataStructure (cdi:isStructuredBy) keyed by the dimensions. Only with --endpoint, and not with --no-data.
When the service prepared the structure message.
The structure query the message answers: {endpoint}dataflow/{agency}/{id}/{version}?references=all&detail=referencepartial.
